name: Romance Kenkyuubu
source:
Welcome to our Romance Studies Club!

As a new member of the Romance Research Club, you will undergo three days of training in a night school setting.
There you will meet and talk with various club members and find your own romance.
The romance of painting, the romance of the stage, the romance of clothing, the romance of science...
The romance of each and every one of them will surely cast a beautiful light on you.

Have a wonderful three days!

[From the [url=https://hosibanasui0.wixsite.com/artwork/game]official website[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到我们的浪漫研究俱乐部！

作为浪漫研究俱乐部的新成员，你将在夜校接受三天的培训。
在那里，你将与不同的俱乐部成员见面并交谈，并找到属于你自己的浪漫。
绘画的浪漫、舞台的浪漫、服装的浪漫、科学的浪漫……
他们每一个人的浪漫一定会给你投下美丽的光芒。

祝你度过愉快的三天！

[来自[url=https://hosibanasui0.wixsite.com/artwork/game]官方网站[/url]]
